scope: Incremental static malicious-behavior review: every changed path full diff plus necessary shared sensitive context; unchanged source ranges reuse the approved immutable baseline. No correctness, vulnerability, quality or performance assessment.

coverage.unchanged_ranges: Explicit per-file base/candidate line mapping in file-review-coverage.json; base full tree exactly matches prior approved candidate tree.

dependencies.note: go.mod, go.sum, package.json, package-lock.json identical; no new/changed install lifecycle. chart.js/helpers remains within existing locked chart.js 4.5.1, new usage is color formatting.

exclusions: Upstream CI/action/toolchain implementations not executed by the central build; changed workflow and Dockerfile full diffs reviewed, including dorny/paths-filter ref change to v4, Go/Node setup versions and image args. These implementations are not certified.
Unchanged approved dependencies and source are not recursively recertified.
No upstream checkout/clone/install/build/tests/scanners or execution during review; subsequent authorized central publication build is not review evidence.
